source: warmline et warmline-app (note 82 ; villa au crépuscule, clé tendue, bureau d'agence vide, archives ; « pas de skyline ni de monument reconnaissable »), h-renovation (maisons après la pluie, notée 4-5), patchacha et cirenza (salons vus de face), talon-libre (coin de lit). Seule maquette immobilière notée : gabarit complété par les plus proches.
style: Contemporary editorial interior and architecture photography, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, realistic materials and textures, true-to-life colours, 35mm lens, subtle depth of field, clean composition with generous negative space, photorealistic.
interdits: No property presented as a real listing, no famous skyline or landmark, no for-sale sign, no agency sign, no readable document, no price, no visible face.
evite: Évite le bien inventé présenté comme réel et la skyline cliché (warmline exclut Dubaï) : intérieurs vides et génériques, clés, portes, lumière ; les biens réels viennent des vraies photos.

404.consigne: A long dark archive room with rows of closed filing drawers fading into cool shadow, one drawer slightly open and empty, emitting a warm glow, no labels, nobody.

ouverture.consigne: The front door of {sujet} opening at dusk, warm interior light spilling onto a pale stone path and a few plants, nobody, generic architecture, not a real listing.
ouverture.evite: Le bien présenté comme à vendre.

section-fond.consigne: A calm, bright living room photographed perfectly straight-on, the camera facing a large empty wall at eye level with no perspective distortion, {matieres}, soft daylight, nobody.
section-fond.source: cirenza voir-au-mur, patchacha (salon vu de face)
section-fond.evite: La décoration chargée qui date l'image.

scene-metier.consigne: Close-up of a single house key on a minimal leather fob being handed from one hand to another, warm side light, dark background, very shallow depth of field, only hands and wrists visible.
scene-metier.evite: Les poignées de main et les sourires d'agent.

lieu.consigne: Interior of a high-floor apartment at night, floor-to-ceiling windows showing a soft out-of-focus field of distant city lights, no identifiable buildings, {lumiere}, empty and quiet.

texture.consigne: Straight-on texture of {matieres}, soft even daylight, filling the whole frame edge to edge, no objects.
texture.evite: Les défauts qui évoquent un bien à rénover.

portrait-generique.consigne: Two people seen from behind standing at a distance in front of an open door at dusk, small in the frame, warm light spilling out, no faces.
portrait-generique.source: warmline (deux personnes de dos devant la porte)
